subject: general
question: A man can walk up a moving-up escalator in 30 seconds. The same man can walk down the same moving-up escalator in 90 seconds. How long would it take him to walk up the escalator when it is not moving?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken to walk up moving-up escalator = 30 sec

Time taken to walk down moving-up escalator = 90 sec

**Formula used:**

Relative speed concept: Speed of man + Speed of escalator = Speed while walking up

Speed of man - Speed of escalator = Speed while walking down

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of the man be M and the speed of the escalator be E. Assume the distance to be D.</
